snapshot.title: ENDEX: Systems Restored — Data Verified

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 13:00. The IIS export job has been re-run and accepted by KDHE. All systems have been restored in sequence: phones and the fax server, email, ClinicTrack EHR, file shares and the outbreak SharePoint site, SlotWise, and finally the IIS export. The catch-up file has been sent. The public has been informed via the CountyNotify system, the MCHD website, and the joint statement. The incident is closed.
finalState: All systems are restored and verified as clean.
The IIS export file for 04-01 has been accepted by KDHE.
The paper mode is terminated and all frontline operations have returned to digital.
The public has been notified via CountyNotify, the MCHD website, and a joint statement.
The hot wash team is now in charge.
